notes.title: Demo Events & Release Date
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=uapU_6_u1IY;full][/previewyoutube]
Yesterday we had an amazing day with exclusive news. First, and most important: Relicta will come out on PC, Stadia, PS4 & Xbox One next August 4th. That’s official! We can FINALLY announce our release date! It was a long journey, so we’re very excited to share this amazing news with all of you! We crave to know your opinion about Relicta, and you only need to wait a little bit more to play it!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33599515/283185e41a34e82ae6ac81f5239089e50b4d1443.png

Besides that, you know that you will be able to play our exclusive one-hour-demo next June 16th at the Steam Game Festival. We would like to apologize for the mistake with yesterday’s trailer since Steam changed the dates at the last minute and we couldn’t change it in time for The Escapist Indie Showcase. We hope you enjoy the demo on June 16th!  

We are bringing back our Discord channel, long time desert but now revitalized! Please join it to share your impressions of Relicta and being more aware of all our news and updates!  

Join our Discord now!  

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33599515/753f64688c353930acabc2ee9c5431f7041351a9.png

Also, next week you will have the opportunity to ask us your questions 😊 You’ll find a special channel on our Discord where you will be able to ask whatever you want during our Ask Me Anything hours (June 18th, 6 PM – 8 PM CEST). If we can’t answer everything, we’ll upload your missing questions on our FAQ channel.  

What is more, next June 17th (19 PM CEST) you can join us on our Steam stream where we will play the demo with you! Mark your calendar!  

We’re very happy to be this active with you, guys.   

Keep experimenting! 
Mighty Polygon
